/**
 * @name Subprocess calls with shell=True
 * @description Finds calls to subprocess functions with shell=True.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true-v2
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  )
  and
  (
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      call.getArgByName("shell") = arg and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // Check for implicit shell usage (os.system/popen always use shell)
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess call with shell=True found."
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess calls with shell=True can allow arbitrary command execution if arguments are untrusted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name OS Symlink Arguments
 * @description Retrieves arguments passed to os.symlink for manual review.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/os-symlink-args
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node src, DataFlow::Node dst
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("symlink").getACall() and
  src = call.getArg(0) and
  dst = call.getArg(1)
select call, "os.symlink called with src: " + src.toString() + " and dst: " + dst.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Symlink targets might be controllable leading to arbitrary file overwrite or creation.
